description: Fable researches and plans the goal, Opus 5 implements and independently reviews it, and Fable verifies completion while routing replanning or concrete follow-up work.

prompts.rielaPromptTemplate: Coordinate {{workflowId}}. Fable owns goal definition, planning, and final acceptance. Opus 5 owns implementation, verification, independent review, and improvement. Loop on review findings or Fable TODOs until the evidence satisfies the goal.
prompts.workerSystemPromptTemplate: Return concise business JSON only. Preserve the markdown goal and plan, changed files, verification evidence, review findings, remaining TODOs, and residual risks.

steps.description: Use Fable to investigate the request and create or revise a testable markdown goal and development plan.
Use Opus 5 to implement or improve the current Fable plan and verify the changed result.
Use an independent Opus 5 session to review implementation quality and request concrete fixes when needed.
Use Fable to compare the accepted Opus result with the goal and decide whether to replan, delegate TODOs, or finish.
Publish the accepted Fable goal, Opus development evidence, verification, changed files, and residual risks.

rielaPackage.title: fable-and-improve-opus
rielaPackage.description: Fable plans and verifies while Claude Opus 5 implements, reviews, and improves the result.
